name: Plugin Settings
description: Every plugin the shell knows in one panel: search and filter, turn plugins on or off, edit the settings their manifests declare, and delete plugins installed under ~/.config/haseen/plugins, one or a selection at a time. Built-ins and the read-only Omarchy and DMS plugin folders are never deleted. Writes go through haseen plugin enable, disable, settings and uninstall. Adopted from t1nk33r.settings (AyushKr2003/shell-settings, MIT); off by default

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.settings (state, setFilter, setQuery, toggle, form, edit, resetKey, save, select, deleteSelected) while the panel is open
